## Executive Summary

Akila Madhushanka is a self-taught Full-Stack Solutions Architect and Senior Software Engineer who began his intensive self-study software development journey in 2017 and has been actively engineering commercial production systems across the industry since 2019 (over 5 years of commercial production experience). As the founder and principal architect of NextGenWare Software Solutions, he has designed, built, and successfully delivered complex enterprise systems, high-traffic web portals, and cross-platform mobile applications for international and local clients across Sweden, the United Kingdom, and Sri Lanka.

His core strengths lie in bridging modern reactive user interfaces with robust, scalable backends. Akila specializes in the Laravel ecosystem, modern Next.js/React architectures, cross-platform Flutter mobile applications, and enterprise database performance optimization.

## Key Portfolio Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Hej-Eko-Stad Service Management Platform (2024)
- **Category:** Client Web Platform / Enterprise Business Portal
- **Client Location:** Sweden
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, PHP, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, Localization
- **Overview:** An end-to-end commercial platform developed for a Swedish eco-cleaning service enterprise.
- **Key Features:**
  - Full bilingual localization (Swedish and English).
  - Custom dynamic quotation calculator for residential and commercial square-meter pricing.
  - Appointment scheduling, real-time availability tracking, and automated customer notifications.
  - High Core Web Vitals optimization for Scandinavian search engine dominance.

### 2. Lion King Restaurant & Dining Operations (2023)
- **Category:** Hospitality & Food Service
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, Livewire, Tailwind CSS, MySQL
- **Overview:** Interactive dining and ordering portal engineered for restaurant guest engagement and kitchen workflow.
- **Key Features:**
  - Reactive single-page food menu with real-time dish modifiers and dietary tags.
  - Online table reservation calendar with administrative booking confirmations.
  - Mobile-first interface designed for dining customers and waitstaff ordering.

### 3. Opviha Foundation Official Portal (2023)
- **Category:** Non-Profit & Community Outreach
- **Status:** Live at https://opviha.org
- **Tech Stack:** Laravel, Livewire Volt, Jetstream, Tailwind CSS, MySQL
- **Overview:** Official organizational CMS and community broadcasting platform.
- **Key Features:**
  - High-speed reactive components using Livewire Volt.
  - Dynamic event scheduling, community newsletters, and media publishing.
  - Administrative content management with role-based access control.

### 4. Paule Sabawa Streaming App & PWA (2023 - 2024)
- **Category:** Multimedia Progressive Web App
- **Tech Stack:** Nuxt 3, Vue 3, Pinia, Plyr, Service Workers (PWA)
- **Overview:** Audio and video streaming app designed for spiritual broadcasts, sermons, and community content.
- **Key Features:**
  - Background audio playback and persistent media controls.
  - Offline playlist caching using service workers and IndexedDB.
  - Cross-device responsive audio/video players.

### 5. Opviha Pahan Tharuwa Media App (2023)
- **Category:** Educational Web App
- **Tech Stack:** Nuxt 3, Vue 3, YouTube Data API, Tailwind CSS
- **Overview:** Educational YouTube playlist curation platform for structured, distraction-free video learning.
